newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-CELTIC LEGEND MCNEILL TO UNDERGO HEART SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CELTIC LEGEND MCNEILL TO UNDERGO HEART SURGERY.

text.p: Billy McNeill, who captained Celtic to victory in the 1967 European Cup Final over Inter Milan, is to undergo a triple heart bypass operation next week, it was reported on Thursday.
McNeill, 57, who had two spells as Celtic's manager and also managed Manchester City and Aston Villa, complained of chest pains last week.
A family member, who asked not to be named, was quoted in the Glasgow Herald on Thursday as saying: "It has come as a shock to Billy. The family cannot believe it because he is so fit."
McNeill played a total of 787 first class games for Celtic between 1959 and 1975 and won virtually every honour available to him in the game.
He also made 29 appearances for Scotland in the 1960s and early 1970s and now works as a media analyst and commentator.
